events.title: RUNTIME's free demo is out now!
events.summary: The RUNTIME demo is live on Steam! Chain midair dashes, catch a crystal to keep going, and turn gravity on its head. Play four campaign chapters, from your first connection to gravity flips and a shadow on your heels. Bring a friend, too. Race online or in local split screen across two courses, or challenge a bot. Play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4455590/RUNTIME/ The full ten-chapter escape is still to come. If you'd like to hear when it launches, add RUNTIME to your Steam

events.title: Keeping your next dash readable
events.summary: One crystal. One more move. A good stretch of RUNTIME can become a chain: jump, dash through a crystal, change direction, and catch the next landing. I've been working on making each part of that sequence easier to read while you're moving. The dash indicator uses a compact pixel meter to distinguish a usable dash from one that's spent or recovering. A crystal refill sends a bright pulse through the meter.
